title: Workflows: Send an Email When Content Is Published | Orchard Core
description:
Editors often need to know when an article goes live, and writing that message by hand takes time and gets skipped.

The Orchard Core Workflows module sends it for you. A workflow starts with the Content Published Event, then runs an Email Task that mails the editors, and you build it in the workflow designer without writing code.

In this video:
• How the workflow works: an event, a task and the outcome that joins them
• What the site needs: features and an email provider
• Create the workflow: a name is all it needs
• Start with an event: Content Published Event and its content type
• Add the email: Email Task, recipients and message
• Publish the workflow: a draft does not run
• Try it: publish an article and read the email
• Make it yours: other events, types and recipients
